tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (app screens, admin main area). Same #F7F7F7 the university site uses.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Section bands, table stripes, the admin sidebar, input fills on surface. Same #F7F7F7 the university site uses for its light sections.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus, dialogs, set apart by shadow-md or a line border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, card borders, table rules. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders. 3:1 or better on surface and surface-alt in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings and numbers that must lead: on surface, surface-alt, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text (the university site's #3B3D42), on every surface and brand-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, helper text, on surface and surface-alt (4.39:1 on brand-soft in light: avoid there).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: SUTech purple (#58286E, Pantone P 94-15U). Primary buttons, active nav item, links, selected states; as text on surface, surface-alt and brand-soft (4.5:1 or better in both themes; dark uses the official 20% tint).

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand; deep end of the hero gradient in light.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brand content: selected rows, active nav pill, info cards about the subscription.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills (primary button label). Light: white on purple 10.8:1. Dark: ink on light purple 7.9:1.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: SUTech teal (#257988, Pantone 126-14U in the brand manual). Secondary actions, live-tracking and route lines, 'info' state, focus ring. As text only on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for live/tracking panels and info banners.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal text and links on light tints.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on teal fills.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: SUTech coral (#CF644B, Pantone P 41-6U). Small accent marks only: arrow tiles on buttons, map stop pins, the 'your stop' dot. Never body text (3.8:1 on white).

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral as text or on-white labels (darker than coral so it reaches 4.5:1 on surface and surface-alt).

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Coral tint behind selected stop chips and accent tiles.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Icons on coral fills (the live bus pin on the map). White on coral is only 3.8:1, so the icon is dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, SOS, destructive actions: fills, icons and borders. The only red in the app. #C62828 was picked over Elsewedy red #D71921 (2026-11-08) because it is clearer: white on it 5.6:1 (vs 5.2:1), and 4.49:1 on danger-soft (vs 4.1:1). Text on danger-soft uses danger-text.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error banners, the SOS sheet and SOS type buttons. Text on it is danger-text, never danger.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Red text: error messages, and any text on danger-soft (5.9:1 light, 5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger fills (SOS button).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Boarded, paid, active subscription. Always paired with a word or a check icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and banners.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success text on success-soft.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Delays, pending payment, reservation about to expire. Paired with a clock or alert icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for delay banners and pending badges.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on warning-soft.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: QR code modules. Always dark on the pass's white quiet zone, in both themes, so every scanner reads it.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted app bar and chips, with blur(12px) saturate(1.6).

tokens.name: skeleton

tokens.name: skeleton-hi
tokens.usage: Loading skeleton shimmer.
